designationHistory.name: Bombay Hook Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Bombay Hook Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7643; it is now Bombay Hook National Wildlife Refuge.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bombay Hook National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
American Presidency Project: Executive Order 7643—Establishing Bombay Hook Migratory Waterfowl Refuge (Jun 22, 1937)

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Bombay Hook was established in 1937 as a link in the chain of refuges extending from Canada to the Gulf of Mexico.
